scope.allowed_numeric_source: FT2-05 census v4 tables cited by exact SHA-256

authoritative_population.unit: one governed session on each policy's complete causal neutral-lifecycle serial ledger
authoritative_population.no_trade_session_value: zero policy PnL; the session is retained

two_layer_acceptance.relationship: ENTRY_COMPONENT_ACCEPTANCE implements the owner's component-freeze decision and authorizes lifecycle work only. PROMOTABLE_COMBINED_SYSTEM implements the signed D1 V2 incremental-dollar law at FT2-80. The component layer cannot satisfy, replace, weaken, or pre-spend alpha from the promotable layer.

entry_component_acceptance.claim: The entry forecasts and composer may be frozen as a component for lifecycle research.

integrity: every authority and upstream hash matches the receipt
FT2-08 identity, role, causality, mask, label, ledger, and replay contracts reproduce
FT2-10 serial population, exact P5-under-cap algorithm, action heads, composer, calibrators, and controls reproduce
independent auditor recomputes from source ledgers

quality_evidence.metric: DeltaQ_session and the five family deltas on the FT2-10 serial population
quality_evidence.role: diagnostic channel proving component quality only; never a dollar or promotion claim
quality_evidence.pooled_rule: For each required comparator the synchronized studentized-maxT adjusted one-sided 95% lower bound for DeltaQ_session is strictly greater than zero and adjusted p is at most 0.05.
quality_evidence.upside_rule: DeltaU_session point estimate is strictly positive and its adjusted upper bound is not below zero.
quality_evidence.family_rule: All five quality-family deltas are reported; at least four point estimates are nonnegative and no family has an adjusted upper bound below zero.

required_artifacts: same-final-model conformalized q90 per-contract RLAC-regret upper bound
frozen one-pass RLAC target and provenance manifests
calibrator hashes and action-head model hash

selected_contract_regret.target_denominator: every label-complete intent-eligible contract on every included RLAC minute, including WAIT minutes; runtime composer selections exclude zero rows
selected_contract_regret.action_rule: every ENTER requires a finite selected-contract q90 normalized-regret upper bound<=0.10; missing, nonfinite, or larger emits WAIT

runtime_selected_subset_coverage.role: report-only conditional diagnostic after the frozen composer runs
runtime_selected_subset_coverage.collapse: owner_decision_required tripwire; never automatic recalibration, relabeling, or acceptance

action_conditioned_calibration.interval_rule: Session-clustered simultaneous bounds must lie on the passing side of every threshold. A bound overlapping a threshold is insufficient_evidence; a bound wholly on the failing side is no_genuine_entry_signal.

all_required: G4 v2 pooled fee-adjusted net PnL divided by pooled maximum drawdown is at least 1.0
equity in every outer fold remains at or above $5,000 from $10,000 start
realized session loss stops new entries at 5% of session-start equity
D48 premium cap is independently enforced
D49 prospective remaining-budget and current-ladder soft close are independently enforced with computed floor costs of 10300 cents on fee_3 and 10400 cents on fee_4
one contract and at most one open position
no overlap, scaling, or revenge trade
$3 and $4 are separate causal account trajectories

serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.estimand: For every governed session, DeltaDollar_session=(candidate neutral-lifecycle serial PnL cents-P5 neutral-lifecycle serial PnL cents)/100 on the two complete policy-causal ledgers; no-trade sessions contribute zero.
serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.margin_interpretation: Exact no-harm: no positive harm tolerance is granted.
serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.pass: The multiplicity-adjusted session-clustered one-sided 95% lower confidence bound is at least 0.00 dollars/session on both the $3 primary and separately replayed $4 stress trajectories.
serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.adjusted_p: At most 0.05 for the one-sided no-harm null on both fee trajectories.
serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.equality: An adjusted lower bound exactly at zero satisfies no-harm but does not prove superiority.
serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.sufficient_harm: If the adjusted upper confidence bound is below 0.00 dollars/session, route no_genuine_entry_signal.
serial_dollar_no_harm_vs_P5.ambiguous: If the simultaneous interval contains zero and the lower bound is below zero, route insufficient_evidence.
forbidden_substitutes: a common account ledger shared by candidate and P5

tail_and_missingness: tripwire_spec.json passes without an owner route, or the owner explicitly resolves the route
the MNAR no-bid ranking-stability output in this file passes

entry_component_acceptance.success_authorizes: FT2-52 owner freeze and lifecycle work only

promotable_combined_system.applies_to: the assembled learned entry plus learned lifecycle on complete serial ledgers

all_required.ledger: complete policy-causal serial ledgers, every governed session retained, all costs included, $3 primary and $4 stress separately replayed
all_required.D1: all signed matching dimensions, shuffled-control validity, identity hashes, and independent reproduction pass

promotable_combined_system.claim: Only this layer can establish a promotable incremental-dollar result.

mnar_no_bid_sensitivity.required_evaluation_output: For every serious candidate, seed, frozen ensemble, alpha arm, and comparator, independently fit and evaluate the complete FT2-10 machinery under primary no-bid-as-full-loss labels and the preregistered no-bid-excluded sensitivity labels.
mnar_no_bid_sensitivity.ranking_score: the preregistered component quality score used before outer results, with identical tie-breaks

refit_all_label_dependent_machinery: all nested empirical CDF knots and fallback manifests
all continuous, binary, survival, count, WAIT, and regret calibrators
WAIT-probability and expected/q90 regret action heads
inner selection and frozen ensemble construction
held_identical_between_views: folds, embargoes, fit/calibration roles, and session identities
alternate_refit_protocol.only_changed_input: primary full-loss labels versus no-bid-excluded sensitivity labels and the deterministic downstream artifacts fit from that label view
alternate_refit_protocol.artifact_requirement: separate complete model/CDF/calibrator/composer/action-head hashes and selection traces for both views
alternate_refit_protocol.no_training_now: This packet freezes the later procedure only; no model is fit by FT2-FINAL-REPAIR.

hard_ranking_stability: the selected lineage and composer variant are identical under both conventions
entry-component terminal is identical under both conventions
every pairwise ordering involving the selected lineage is unchanged

threshold_basis.interpretation: The 0.95 candidate-ranking floor is below the observed census-v4 label-surface diagnostic and is still subordinate to exact selected-identity and terminal invariance.

mnar_no_bid_sensitivity.too_few_serious_identities_for_rank_corr: Report not_applicable for Spearman only; exact selected-identity, terminal, and pairwise rules remain hard.
